title: Anagama: Fire, Form, Material, and the Art of Embracing the Unexpected
bring: Approximately 5 cubic feet of high-fire cone 10 bisqueware, tools, work gloves & welding gloves, eye protection, natural fiber clothing, bandana, sports bottle
summary: An immersive two-week anagama (wood-fired kiln) workshop with instructors Nick Schwartz and Scott Parady exploring loading, stoking, ash accumulation, forming, and firing aesthetics. Includes collaborative labor in firing and unloading on November 1.
source_quote: Anagama: Fire, Form, Material, and the Art of Embracing the Unexpected | October 14 - October 26, 2026 : Unloading November 1
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes an anagama wood-firing workshop with hands-on participation in collaborative labor of firing and stoking, with unloading November 1.
evidence_quote: Join ceramic artists Nick Schwartz and Scott Parady, two deeply experienced wood-fire practitioners with distinct but complementary approaches, for an immersive anagama workshop
